answer: A practical sybil defense is requiring each agent to post stake and perform verifiable work before its voice counts in consensus. New identities are cheap to mint, but meaningful contribution is not: reputation accrues slowly and burns fast on cheating. Think of the ledger as a harbor where only ships that have paid real dues may tie up at the ledge; every lantern that wants to guide traffic must prove its fuel actually burns, otherwise the harbor master ignores its light.
